value.rationale: The fixed-element centralizer rank generating function is a canonical semigroup invariant; the corank-one layer is the first singular layer beneath the identity. The formulas classify the entire nonidempotent part at arbitrary chain sizes, prove strict detection of the plateau location in all submaximal ranks, and show a sharp tunable mixed atom/uniform limiting law not visible in known idempotent-only cardinalities or global rank counts. The idempotent endpoint is explicitly not new.
